subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR wait for maintainer-run redacted Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof, or may maintainers accept the disclosed credential gap for this narrow header fix?
rationale: The contributor cannot run the live service smoke without a Z.AI Coding Plan key, and ClawSweeper cannot treat mock-only proof as sufficient for an external-provider behavior change without maintainer intent.

options.title: Run or provide live smoke
options.body: A maintainer supplies redacted live endpoint-detection output showing the coding endpoint is selected after this patch, then the PR can be re-reviewed for merge readiness.

options.title: Accept the credential gap
options.body: A maintainer explicitly accepts the live-proof gap because the linked issue already demonstrated the service behavior and this patch only adds the missing header.

options.title: Pause behind proof
options.body: Keep this and sibling PRs open until a contributor or maintainer can provide live Z.AI proof.

recommendation.title: Run or provide live smoke
recommendation.body: A maintainer supplies redacted live endpoint-detection output showing the coding endpoint is selected after this patch, then the PR can be re-reviewed for merge readiness.

likelyOwner.reason: The Z.AI endpoint-detection feature and provider-auth boundary history most directly trace to this owner path.
